Family mediation

Mediation gives you both a say in what happens next. You set the agenda; we keep the conversation safe and moving.

How it works

  1. A free first call with each of you, separately.
  2. Joint sessions, usually two to four, at our rooms or online.
  3. A written summary of what you agreed, for your solicitors if you wish.
Is mediation confidential?

Yes. What is said in mediation stays in mediation, except where someone is at risk of harm.

Do we have to be in the same room?

No. Shuttle mediation keeps you in separate rooms while the mediator moves between you.
